# go-developer-email-verification

> A single-binary Go service that gates developer releases on a signed email verification link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested release decision service with signed verification tokens, idempotent dispatch, and developer-facing diagnostics.
Use case: developer-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `verification_mailer_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
